meta.title: Apolo Mattress Shopify Ecommerce — Case Study | Teknoppy
meta.description: How Teknoppy built apolomattress.com on Shopify for a Kerala mattress manufacturer, with product-fit guidance, surfaced Google reviews, and a purchase-hesitation-busting FAQ.

sections.h1Lead: Apolo Mattress: A Shopify Store Built to

paragraphs.text: Apolo Mattress is a Kerala-based mattress manufacturer selling memory foam, latex, pocket spring, and foam mattresses, along with pillows and mattress protectors, backed by a 15-year warranty. Teknoppy's goal was to build a Shopify store that could help customers confidently choose between four different mattress types for a high-consideration, hard-to-return purchase, while surfacing the trust signals — reviews, warranty, delivery terms — that matter most before someone buys a mattress online.

items.title: No product-fit guidance
items.text: With four different mattress types (memory foam, latex, pocket spring, foam), customers likely had no clear way to match their sleep needs — back pain, firmness preference, budget — to a specific product.

items.title: No visible social proof
items.text: Google reviews existed but likely weren't surfaced directly on the storefront, leaving new visitors to search elsewhere for reassurance before a high-value purchase.

items.title: No purchase-hesitation FAQ
items.text: Questions around warranty, returns, delivery timing, COD availability, and sizing likely weren't answered upfront, leaving customers to ask before committing to a mattress they can't easily return.

items.title: Product-fit guidance built into the FAQ and product callouts (directly answers Problem 1)
items.text: A dedicated "Which Apolo Mattress is best for back pain?" FAQ answer, alongside per-product feature callouts (pressure relief, firm support, natural flexibility), helps customers match their sleep needs to the right product.

items.title: Google reviews surfaced directly on the homepage (directly answers Problem 2)
items.text: A dedicated reviews section pulls real customer reviews with star ratings and a link to view all Google reviews, building trust before a customer ever reaches a product page.

items.title: A comprehensive FAQ answering key purchase concerns (directly answers Problem 3)
items.text: Warranty terms, return/exchange policy, delivery timelines, COD availability, and size guidance (Single/Double/Queen/King) are all answered upfront, reducing pre-purchase hesitation for a hard-to-return item.

items.title: Trust badges surfaced site-wide
items.text: 15-year warranty, free shipping, easy exchange & return, and premium material badges are shown prominently on the homepage.

items.q: What was the main goal of the Apolo Mattress Shopify project?
items.a: To build a store that helps customers confidently choose the right mattress for their needs and answers the key questions — warranty, returns, delivery, sizing — before they buy.

items.q: What mattresses does Apolo Mattress sell?
items.a: Memory Hug (memory foam), Latexa (pure latex), Spring Fit (pocketed spring), and Dream Fit (foam) mattresses, along with pillows and mattress protectors.

items.q: Did the project affect Apolo Mattress's existing rankings?
items.a: The project was scoped to avoid keyword cannibalization across the site's product and collection pages — no overlapping targets were introduced.
